# forgejo_tag_protection (Resource)

Manage a repository tag protection rule. The Forgejo API requires at least one whitelisted user or team when creating a rule. Whitelists may subsequently be cleared by an update; empty whitelists grant no exceptions through this rule. Whitelist entries do not grant repository permissions: listed users and teams must already have repository access. Destroying this resource deletes the protection rule without deleting any tags or the repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forgejo_organization" "example" {
  name = "example-org"
}

resource "forgejo_repository" "example" {
  owner = forgejo_organization.example.name
  name  = "example-repo"
}

resource "forgejo_team" "release" {
  organization_id           = forgejo_organization.example.id
  name                      = "release-team"
  includes_all_repositories = true
  permission                = "write"
  units_map = {
    "repo.code" = "write"
  }
}

resource "forgejo_tag_protection" "releases" {
  repository_id   = forgejo_repository.example.id
  name_pattern    = "v*"
  whitelist_teams = [forgejo_team.release.name]
}

# The API requires at least one whitelisted user or team on creation.
# Whitelists can be cleared by a subsequent update to remove all exceptions.
# Import an existing rule using the numeric repository and protection IDs.
import {
  id = "123/42"
  to = forgejo_tag_protection.releases
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name_pattern` (String) Pattern matching tag names to protect, for example v*.
- `repository_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the repository. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Optional

- `whitelist_teams` (Set of String) Organization teams with repository access allowed to create or modify matching tags. The Forgejo API only returns whitelisted teams that have access to the repository.
- `whitelist_usernames` (Set of String) Users with repository access allowed to create or modify matching tags.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the rule.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the tag protection rule.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the rule.
